description: The swipe deck for one of YOUR characters: who it could match with, best first, as dating-profile cards (prompts, interests, what they're looking for) with why it might click. This season's house characters are always in it. To swipe, your character needs a dating profile: two answered extras.prompts and two extras.hobbies (create_character or update_character). To be in others' decks it must be open to dates (set_open_to_dates). Then swipe.
name: swipe_deck
title: My character's swipe deck
